title: Revalidate the exact kept root selection before refreshing the session tuple after publication
outcome: A same-root re-name cannot overwrite a newer reconciled or retired root tuple after off-lock authority publication.
acceptance: The kept refresh rechecks the exact current selection under the reacquired state lock and does not install an obsolete tuple if selection or canonical proof has moved.
A deterministic interleaving test drives selection/reconciliation changes during off-lock publication and verifies the newer state is preserved and strict capture fences remain.
